comparison: The same native app/model using ordinary tools and ordinary tools plus fr, twice per task.
publication: User approved patches and summary only. Full logs, prompts, exports, source archives and execution packets stay local.
accounting: CLI-reported categories retain client meanings. Unknown account charges and incomplete usage are not replaced with zero.
cache_state: Fresh conversations and projects, with a separate new .fr/cache for each attempt. Operating-system and provider caches are uncontrolled.
resource_scope: Elapsed time covers the complete controller attempt. CPU and RSS samples describe the native CLI process group. The outer workstation guard also covers controller preparation and capture.

assumptions: rust parsing, semantic IR extraction and SHA-256 remain trusted.
The supported kernel excludes effects, mutation, calls, unsafe code and partial source access.
Numeric widths, source overflow, floating-point coercion and native arithmetic require separate correspondence evidence; Int and Nat models use Lean arithmetic.
rust parsing, semantic IR extraction and SHA-256 remain trusted.
The supported kernel excludes effects, mutation, calls, unsafe code and partial source access.
Numeric widths, source overflow, floating-point coercion and native arithmetic require separate correspondence evidence; Int and Nat models use Lean arithmetic.

Rust i64 division and remainder use Lean Int.tdiv and Int.tmod, which truncate toward zero. Lean arithmetic is total; source division by zero and signed-64 overflow require separate exclusion or failure evidence. This is not a proof of source arithmetic safety.

arithmetic.model: Lean mathematical Int with truncating division
